title: Tech Note: Process HTML Tags and more!
featured_technology: Process HTML Tags (4D web templating command)
4D built-in Web Server dynamic page generation

historical_commentary.text: This note promotes a single classic-language command (Process HTML Tags) as a highly versatile tool for tasks ranging from mail-merge-style document generation to maintenance routines, reflecting the tag-substitution style of dynamic web/document publishing common in 4D's mid-2000s web server era. Only the on-page teaser survived in this archive pass, so the specific techniques demonstrated cannot be confirmed, but the general approach of server-side HTML tag substitution is now a legacy pattern superseded by 4D's REST/ORDA-based web architecture and modern templating engines.
related_updates: 4D's web development has moved toward REST APIs (built on ORDA since 2018) combined with modern client-side frameworks rather than server-side HTML tag substitution
4D Write Pro (2016) and other newer document-generation tools now handle merge-style document creation rather than raw HTML tag processing
